notes.subject: תחת השבט
notes.rationale: 'pass under the rod' — allusion to Lev 27:32, counting tithed flock one by one under the shepherd's staff; 'ka fase ga molamuri' keeps the picture

notes.subject: במסרת
notes.rationale: 'bond' (from אסר, to bind) vs 'discipline/chastisement' (from מסר); most versions read bond of the covenant

notes.subject: toIsrael
notes.rationale: Yahwe addresses the exiles concerning the future purification

translation: Gomme ke tla dira gore lo tselle ka fase ga molamuri, gomme ke tla dira gore lo tselle thogwanong ya kgwerano.
